name: Hostel Onboarding Guide
text:
Hostel Onboarding Guide

First Year Students (July 2026)

BHOPAL

wwvitbhopal.ac.in

PLAN YOUR ARRIVAL BETWEEN 8:30 AM AND 4:30 PM ONLY

Pre-Onboarding Packing List
Studentsareadvised tocarry the following:

¢ Hostel allotment proof, affidavit and prescribed
forms

¢ Government-issued photo ID of
the student and accompanying
parent/guardian

\¥
e Weather-appropriate clothing
Rainy season: Rain jacket and
umbrella
Winter: Warmer, sweater, jackets

and thick bedsheet (kambal) -

e Water bottle and personal
essentials, Pillow, bedsheet
bedspread, bucketand mug

¢ Mattresswill be provided by VIT Bhopal.
e Locks

e Lock 1 - Room Lock - For shared
accommodation, the room lock must have one
key for each occupant. For example, a three-
bedded room must have a lock with at least
three keys.

e Lock 2 - Cupboard Lock - A medium-sized
personal lock is required to secure your
cupboard. Students are responsible for
securing their personal belongings. These
items are also available at stalls within the
campus premises.

Parent & Guardian Information

¢ Shamiana tents with seating arrangements will
be available near the hostel blocks for the
comfort of parents and guardians.

e Parents/guardians are not permitted to enter
hostel buildings beyond the entrance.

e Kindly respect the privacy and safety of
studentsresiding in the hostels.

e Accommodation for parents or accompanying
persons will not be provided on campus.

e All are requested to strictly follow the security
protocols of VIT Bhopal University.

Hostel Onboarding Checklist

(Documents to be carried by Student)

¢ Hostel affidavit e Consentletter

e Undertaking by the hostel Resident

e Hostel Allotment Proof

e Hostel Fee Payment Receipt, f
ifalready paid

¢ Photocopy of University ID card

¢ Photocopy of the Aadhar card

e Threerecent passport-size colour photographs
of the student

* Recentpassport-size photograph of Parent &
Local Guardian, ifapplicable

Don’ts - Electrical
Appliances

Students must not bring unauth-
orised electrical appliances,
including: Electric kettle, sound
system, desktop computer,
coffee maker, room heater,
portable heater/fan, iron box,
immersion heating rod, hair
dryer, or similar electrical
appliances.

Health Check-up &

Medical Disclosure

e A mandatory paid health
check-up for all students will
be conducted at the
Dr. Morepen Health Centre on
campus.

e Students must undergo the
health check-up as per the
schedule and instructions
communicated by the
University.

e Students with any existing
health condition, ongoing
treatment, allergy, or other
significant health concern
must bring relevant medical
records, prescriptions,
investigation reports, or other
supporting documents for
verification and reference.

e Any health concern should be
properly disclosed during the
mandatory health check-up to
enable appropriate medical
support, whenever required.

e Residents must hold a valid
prescription from a registered
doctor for any medication
they possess, whether for
short-term or long-term
treatment.

If you report before your
roommates, kindly leave the
room key at the Hostel Block
Office after unlocking the room.
This will ensure that your
roommates can access the room
when they arrive.

Shuttle Bus Facility

e University-arranged buses will
ferry students and parents from
Academic Block 2 (AB2) to the
Boys’ and Ladies’ Hostels,
respectively.

e Personal vehicles are not

allowed in the residential
hostelzone.

Reporting Location ®
Important Instructions: |
Academic
¢ Token-based system. Block 2 (AB2)

Only students are allowed in the queue.
Dedicated counters will be available

for smooth processing.

Waiting facilities will be available for Parents /
Guardians at the designated locations.

Allow Sufficient Time for Onboarding

The complete on-boarding process involves multiple
stages and may take several hours or, in some cases,
most of the day. Students and parents are advised to
plan their return journey accordingly and avoid
booking trains, flights, buses, or other travel with
tight departure schedules on the day of on-boarding.

Requests for priority processing or bypassing the
queue due to pre-booked travel arrangements will
not be entertained. All students must follow the
prescribed queue and on-boarding sequence.

Academic & Hostel Formalities

Students must first complete the required academic

formalities & then hostel formalities:

e ID card issuance ® Academic & Hostel document
verification. ® Any other prescribed academic
on-boarding formalities

e Submit the following if you are a Hostelier:

e Photocopy of the University ID Card

o All other required hostel documents

Hostel On-boarding Process

After completing the Academic Formalities:
¢ Proceed to the Hostel Counter in the same queueline.

Complete the Hostel Document Verification.
Collect the Hostel Allotment Slip.

Visit your allotted Hostel Block Office with the
Hostel Allotment Slip.

Hostel Check-in & Mattress Distribution

After reaching the allotted Hostel Block, the
student must visit the Hostel Block Office and
complete the room check-in process.

After completion of check-in, mattresses will be
provided from the designated distribution point
attherespective hostel block.

Volunteers will guide students through the
process.

Queue discipline is mandatory. Please cooperate
toavoid delays.

Do not give money or tips to helpers, labourers,
volunteers, or any other personnel.

Campus Amenities

The following facilities are available at the Recreational
Block: ¢ Food Court & Restaurants e Photocopy &
Courier ® Printing & Stationery e Laptop & Mobile
Service Centre ® Cosmetics, Skin & Hair Care Store ® SPA
(Separate facilities for Boys and Girls) ¢ Gymnasium

Students who have not yet
paid the Hostel Fee

Students who have not completed
the hostel fee payment must
follow this procedure:

e Complete the Hostel
Document Verification.

o After successful document
verification, the hostel fee
invoice will be generated.

o The hostel fee must then be
paid online against the
generated invoice.

e Complete the remaining hostel
on-boarding and check-in
process after fulfilling the
prescribed fee payment and
documentation requirements.

Spot Allotment Students
Students allotted rooms through
Spot Allotment must also follow
the same hostel fee payment
procedure and submit all
required documents before
completing the hostel check-in
process.

Campus Conduct & Etiquette
* Maintain silence in academic
zones and hostel corridors.

e Follow queue lines at all

counters and bus stops.

e Room allotments are final
during on-boarding. No
exchange or room change
requests will be entertained
atthisstage.

¢ Do not approach the Hostel
Office in person, through
email, phone calls, or
recommendations for room

SOP – Hostel Room Change Requests
SOP – Hostel Room Change Requests
VIT Bhopal University
Hostel Administration & Student Affairs
Standard Operating Procedure
SOP – Hostel Room Change Requests
a)
Students seeking a room change must submit the duly filled
Hostel – Application for Room Change
in the prescribed format only. Incomplete applications shall not be processed.
b)
The student must clearly indicate whether the request is:
For the same room/bed type or a different room/bed type, and
Within the same block or across blocks.
c)
Requests for the same room type, same bed, and same block:
May be reviewed and approved by the respective FR, subject to room availability.
The FR shall record remarks and sign the application with date and employee ID.
d)
Requests involving a change in room type and bed type:
Must be forwarded by the FR to the Member Secretary, Hostel Administrative Council
(MS–HAC).
Such requests must include a parent consent email/letter along with relevant
supporting documents.
Applications without parent consent shall not be forwarded.
e)
Upon approval by MS–HAC, cases involving a change in room where the bed type is
upgraded will be routed to the Finance Office for the extra/additional fee payment and
confirmation. No room change shall be executed without Finance confirmation.
f)
After completion of all approvals and finance confirmation:
The Block Supervisor shall coordinate the physical room shift,
Record old and new room check-in and check-out dates, and
Update the room details in VTOP.
g)
Any unauthorized room shifting or deviation from the above SOP shall be treated as a
violation of hostel regulations.
You are requested to strictly adhere to this SOP while processing and forwarding hostel
room change requests to avoid delays, ambiguity, and student grievances.
 Issued by the Hostel Administrative Council · VIT Bhopal University

Circular
Temporary Vacating Form & Hostel Departure Procedure for Summer Break 2026
As the Summer Break approaches, all hostel residents are requested to complete the
departure formalities in a timely manner for a smooth and hassle-free exit from
campus.
1. Hostel Fee Clearance
Before initiating any vacating process, students are required to ensure that all
applicable hostel dues are cleared.
2. Temporary Vacating Form (Mandatory)
All hostel students must fill and submit the Temporary Vacating Form before leaving
the campus for Summer Break.
Applicable to:
All hostel residents
Exempted:
Final Year completed students who are permanently vacating
3. Hostel No-Dues Form (Only for Eligible Categories)
Students may apply for the Hostel No-Dues Form only if they fall under any one of the
following categories:
Students who have
completed Final Year
Students
placed in a company
with a
valid PAT signed letter
Students proceeding for
International Internship
with a supporting letter signed by the
International Relations Office
Students who have obtained
NLDS approval
from the competent authority
4. Special Note for Capstone Review Students
Students who have completed all course requirements and credits, are not
participating in placements, and will return only for Capstone Review during the next
 academic year (due to internship / higher studies / civil services preparation) may
complete the Hostel No-Dues Form during their first Capstone Review visit.
Students planning this option are strongly advised to take all personal belongings with
them now to avoid future inconvenience.
5. For Continuing Students
Students returning for:
Placements
Pending courses
Regular academic activities
Upcoming semester requirements
should submit only the
Temporary Vacating Form
and should not apply for Hostel No-Dues unless specifically eligible.
6. Important Advisory
Please complete all formalities well in advance to ensure a smooth departure process
and avoid last-minute delays.
For any clarification, students may contact the Hostel Office.
Hostel Office · VIT Bhopal University
